history.summary: Integrated development sitting atop Compass One mall with direct access to Sengkang MRT/LRT and bus interchange — unbeatable convenience at a low $1.8M quantum for a large 1,324 sqft 3BR. PSF 1360 is just ~1% above the URA median and 7.7%/yr resale CAGR is the strongest of the Serangoon/Sengkang names. Aging 2003 build and common-area upkeep gripes keep it a Buy rather than Strong Buy.
history.rating_rationale: The integrated-development premium is the thesis: directly above Compass One, with Sengkang MRT (NEL), LRT and bus interchange below — the kind of doorstep connectivity that holds resale value. 7.7%/yr resale CAGR (highest among the non-Punggol D19 names) on 80 txns, a $1.8M quantum in the deep buyer band, and a large 1,324 sqft layout all support the case. PSF 1360 is essentially at-median (URA 1344), so not a discount but fair for the location. Offsets: 2003 build (23 years), and reviews flag aging common-area upkeep (smell/pests at the L1 MRT entrance). The convenience moat outweighs the age drag.
red_flags: 2003 build (23 years) — aging; reviews cite common-area maintenance issues (smell, pests at L1)
PSF slightly above median — fair, not cheap
Mixed-use/above-mall living means some footfall and noise trade-offs
catalysts: Integrated with Compass One mall + Sengkang MRT/LRT/bus interchange — premium, durable connectivity
7.7%/yr resale CAGR, the strongest among the batch's Serangoon/Sengkang resale names
Low $1.8M quantum for a large 3BR keeps the buyer pool wide
